name: Velvet Lounge
summary: One continuous shot from his seat on a sofa. She walks toward him across a dim luxe lounge, kneels between his legs and runs her hands over his thighs and shorts, talking up at him the whole time.

start.composition: a wide point-of-view photo from a man seated low on a sofa, his bare knees and thighs and his light grey shorts spread toward the camera at the bottom edge of the frame, she stands a few steps away facing the camera, her whole body in frame, smiling at him
start.outfit: a lilac satin slip mini dress with thin straps
start.setting: warm dim amber light, in a luxurious lounge with tufted taupe velvet armchairs, dark panelled walls and glowing brass table lamps
start.negative: his face, a second man, extra legs, high angle

legs: she walks slowly toward the camera, smiling, her eyes on the lens
she stops in front of him, leans forward with her hands on her knees, then lowers herself to her knees between his legs
kneeling between his legs, she rests her hands on his thighs and talks up at him
her hands slide slowly up his thighs and over the front of his shorts, a teasing smile
she leans in closer, still rubbing slowly, holding eye contact
leg_suffix: handheld point of view from a man seated on a sofa, his knees and thighs fixed at the bottom of the frame, continuous shot, no cuts, smooth natural motion
video_negative: camera cut, scene change, morphing, face change, extra fingers, distorted hands, flicker, different person, his face
script:
